items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Bessie had recorded a blues, called it Sobbing Blues.

ctx.x: Now, this might be interesting to you. During that time, must be around ... maybe I did but we had a lot of things to talk about. During that time I'm studying, too. I mean the great Louis Armstrong. Please don't misunderstand me because he knew how I felt about him. Oh, there came a time during that time, Bessie had recorded a blues, called it Sobbing Blues.
